outcomes.question: What has happened with this idea since this was written?
outcomes.text:
It has drawn a fair amount of response, which could feed your group's discussion. The essay [won the 2025 Berggruen essay prize](https://www.noemamag.com/only-what-is-alive-can-be-conscious/). Seth then [discussed it in a Lawfare podcast](https://www.lawfaremedia.org/article/scaling-laws--ai-consciousness-with-anil-seth), covering the arguments for and against machine consciousness and what labs and policymakers should do. Critics come from two sides. One post [argues consciousness might not need biology](https://paulchristoperwalton.substack.com/p/what-if-anil-seth-is-wrong-that-conscious). Another says Seth [still keeps a subtle dualism](https://medium.com/@Lidinwise/why-the-mythology-of-conscious-ai-misses-the-deeper-point-437589461d45). Both are blog-level responses, so weigh them accordingly.

For a discussion, the live disagreement is probably the "life matters" argument, which Seth himself calls short of a knock-down case [spya-hj5y6s].

outcomes.question: What has happened with this idea since this was written?
outcomes.text:
Three things are worth knowing before your group meets.

The piece updates itself. Its opening summary points to a May 2022 followup, "Scaling Hypothesis Revisited", plus Situational Awareness and AI 2027 [spya-ewxv9q]. A later editor's note answers its own "arms race" question with "Roughly, yes" [spya-rbx2kz].

Outside the piece, the main refinement is that Hoffmann et al. (2022) showed many LLMs, including GPT-3 and Gopher, were under-trained relative to their parameter count. The live argument is about diminishing returns. One source notes that each successive model used about 70 times as much compute as the one before. Others argue that small per-step gains can still compound into much longer tasks (that small improvements can still make the length of tasks completed grow exponentially).

For discussion, compare its loss forecast [spya-edr6mj] with what happened. Which update would your group most want to check?
